intent: Verify whether the Bondex Garden Classic 106-TS1 Wood Stain and Deck Oil line has a catalogue variant of product type 'wood stain' with volume 1000 ml, and cite the exact product record.
success_criteria: Base product line (brand Bondex, name containing 'Garden Classic 106-TS1 Wood Stain and Deck Oil') is located in product_variants
Existence of a variant with product kind 'wood stain' AND volume 1000 ml is determined
Answer cites the exact checked SKU and its full record_path
If base exists but the wood-stain/1000ml claim is absent, answer is <NO> with the checked SKU

args.stdin: WITH base AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, pv.brand, pv.series, pv.model, pv.product_name, pv.product_kind_id, pk.product_kind_name FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_kinds pk ON pk.product_kind_id = pv.product_kind_id WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pv.product_name LIKE '%' || :line || '%'), withvol AS (SELECT b.*, vp.property_value_number AS volume_ml FROM base b LEFT JOIN product_variant_properties vp ON vp.product_sku = b.product_sku AND vp.property_key = 'volume_ml') SELECT product_sku, record_path, product_name, product_kind_name, volume_ml, CASE WHEN lower(product_kind_name) = lower(:product_kind) AND volume_ml = :volume_ml THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS claim_match FROM withvol ORDER BY claim_match DESC, product_sku;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products.
see sql tool that takes SQLite query as stdin. It operates with the state of the entire catalogue at the start of the session.

answer_template.message: Checked Bondex Garden Classic 106-TS1 Wood Stain and Deck Oil line. Base product exists (SKU {rows.product_sku}, {rows.record_path}), but no catalogue variant of product type 'wood stain' with volume 1000 ml is present — the claimed item is absent. <NO>
